title: Deep Winter
description: Deep Winter is a mod that adds a post-apocalyptic winter theme.
body:
Deep Winter is a chilling mod that introduces a new, desolate biome — DeepWinterBiome.
In this frozen wasteland, life has all but vanished — no trees, no animals, only endless snow and silence.

Beware the DeepWinterFogEffect — a blinding, icy fog that engulfs anyone exposed to the harsh cold.
Seek refuge in a shelter, cave, or any solid structure to clear your vision and survive the storm.

(SET WORLD GENERATION TO SINGLE BIOM THIS WILL BE FIXED SOON)
